data.definition: The design, implementation, and analysis of large-scale assessments of engineering competencies, often involving international collaborations, multi-institutional participation, or cross-cultural validation to benchmark student performance and inform curriculum improvements.

data.theme: Pedagogical Interventions and Learning Outcomes Assessment
data.definition: The development and evaluation of pedagogical strategies, curricular changes, or interventions (e.g., flipped classrooms, problem-based learning) aimed at enhancing engineering students' competencies, assessed through pre- and post-intervention measures of learning gains and skill development.
